tls_enforced.quote: SSL/TLS connections provide a layer of security by encrypting data that moves between your client and DB instance or cluster.

tls_version.quote: You can use Secure Socket Layer (SSL) or Transport Layer Security (TLS) from your application to encrypt a connection to a database running Db2, MariaDB, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle, or PostgreSQL.

max_user_connections.quote: DB parameter groups act as a container for engine configuration values that are applied to one or more DB instances.
terraform_properties: aws_db_parameter_group.parameter { name = "max_user_connections", value is a positive integer }

audit_log_enabled.quote: Amazon RDS offers an audit plugin for MySQL database instances based on the open source MariaDB Audit Plugin.

audit_log_events.quote: SERVER_AUDIT_EVENTS valid values include CONNECT, QUERY, QUERY_DDL, QUERY_DML, QUERY_DML_NO_SELECT, and QUERY_DCL.
terraform_properties: aws_db_parameter_group.parameter { name = "server_audit_events", value includes CONNECT, QUERY_DCL, QUERY_DDL, QUERY_DML or equivalent CONNECTION, DCL, DDL, DML aliases }

public_network_access.quote: Because the subnets are private, no requests from the internet are permitted.

subnet_group.quote: You can run a DB instance on a virtual private cloud (VPC) using the Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC) service.

security_groups.quote: A security group controls the access to a DB instance by allowing access to IP address ranges or Amazon EC2 instances that you specify.
terraform_properties: aws_db_instance.vpc_security_group_ids is set to approved security groups

backup_retention.quote: If necessary, you can recover your DB instance to any point in time during the backup retention period.

deletion_protection.quote: If you choose to have Amazon RDS create a final DB snapshot before it deletes your DB instance, you can use that to recover your DB instance.

high_availability.quote: You can get high availability with a primary DB instance and a synchronous secondary DB instance that you can fail over to when problems occur.

cmk_encryption.quote: Amazon RDS uses an AWS Key Management Service key to encrypt these resources.
terraform_properties: aws_db_instance.kms_key_id is set to a customer-managed KMS key

iam_auth.quote: You can use IAM to centrally manage access to your database resources, instead of managing access individually on each DB instance.

cloudwatch_logs.quote: With CloudWatch Logs, you can perform real-time analysis of the log data, and use CloudWatch to create alarms and view metrics.

storage_autoscaling.quote: It's important to have sufficient storage so that your databases have room to grow.

instance_class.quote: You can select the DB instance class that best meets your requirements.
terraform_properties: aws_db_instance.instance_class uses a non-burstable production class

version.quote: Each DB engine has its own supported features, and each version of a DB engine can include specific features.

maintenance_window.quote: Amazon RDS manages backups, software patching, automatic failure detection, and recovery.
